name: Parameters.placeClass_placeOfInt_eq_neg_one
summary: Units are equal when their values are; prove both directions.

steps.claim: placeClass(P, d)(placeOfInt(P, s, ν)) = −1 as units (d the proof of N₀(P) ∣ N₁(P, s)) if and only if their values in ℤ/N₀(P) agree; show both directions.

(⇒) If ν is not a unit mod N₁(P, s), placeOfInt(P, s, ν) = 1 has class 1, and 1 ≠ −1 in ℤ/N₀(P) (`pow_d_ne_neg_one` for n = 0); otherwise the class of placeOfInt(P, s, ν) mod N₀(P) is ν mod N₀(P), so its value −1 means ν ≡ −1.
(⇐) If ν ≡ −1 mod N₀(P), then ν is prime to N₀(P) and the class of placeOfInt(P, s, ν) is ν = −1 (`placeClass_placeOfInt`).
